old_caption: The video captures a mountainous landscape partially obscured by thick, swirling clouds. The clouds drift slowly, intermittently revealing and concealing the rocky, snow-dusted slopes below. The lighting is diffuse, casting soft highlights on the rock textures and the translucent edges of the clouds. No animals or characters are visible. The overall mood is tranquil and mysterious, emphasizing the natural beauty of the scene as the clouds move across the mountain.
original_wisa_caption: The video captures a serene and dynamic scene of a mountainous landscape partially shrouded by thick, swirling clouds. The camera remains stationary throughout the sequence, focusing on the interplay between the misty clouds and the rugged terrain below. The clouds, dense and billowing, obscure parts of the mountain, creating an ethereal atmosphere. As the video progresses, the clouds shift and move, revealing glimpses of the rocky, snow-dusted slopes beneath. The lighting suggests either early morning or late afternoon, casting soft, diffused light that enhances the textures of the rocks and the translucence of the clouds. There are no visible animals or characters in the scene, allowing the natural beauty of the landscape to take center stage. The overall mood is one of tranquility and mystery, inviting viewers to imagine what lies beyond the veil of the clouds.
caption: The video captures a steep, snow- and rock-dusted mountainside in the lower-left corner, while dense billowing white-gray cloud fills the rest. The right side of the cloud mass is brightly sunlit, contrasting with the darker, shadowed region on the left and center. Throughout, the cloud continuously churns and deforms, its internal texture and edges shifting as the boundary between dark and bright masses moves. The sunlit cloud shifts toward the center while the darker region reshapes and drifts nearby. A thin, near-vertical bright streak remains near a fixed horizontal position at center-bottom, growing intermittently clearer or hazier as cloud drifts across it. The snow-dusted ridge stays in roughly the same screen position, sometimes more or less obscured by the rolling mist. The framing appears largely steady, so the dominant motion is the cloud's own rolling and translation.

draft_caption: The video captures a steep, snow- and rock-dusted mountainside in the lower-left corner, while dense billowing white-gray cloud fills the rest. The right side of the cloud mass is brightly sunlit, contrasting with the darker, shadowed region on the left and center. Throughout, the cloud continuously churns and deforms, its internal texture and edges shifting as the boundary between dark and bright masses moves. The sunlit cloud gradually encroaches toward the center while the shadowed region reshapes and drifts along the slope. A thin, near-vertical bright streak stays at a fixed horizontal position near the center-bottom, growing intermittently clearer or hazier as vapor passes before it. The snow-dusted ridge stays in roughly the same screen position, sometimes more or less obscured by the rolling mist. The overall framing holds steady, so the dominant motion is the cloud's own rolling and translation.
